title: Yiɗɓe Goonga Humble
intro: E nder leydi doole e majjere ɓooynde, pottital mawngal ina waɗa. Bannge gooto ina jogii mbaawka maandeeji diineeji, bannge goɗɗo oo ina etoo yahdude e ko waawaa waɗde. Ko heddii koo maa waylu haa abada yahdu daartol. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sifaa seedtiiɓe goonga timmuɗo oo, lesɗinɓe koye mum en e yeeso mum ?
clues: En njiyii maale ɗe njahdaani e peeje majjere
Enen fof en njippiima e sujjande, en mbaawaa yeddude goonga
En nganndii wonde ɗeen maale ummorii ko e Alla gooto Goonga oo
Ko min renndo gadano jaɓɓaade iimanaagal e ngalɗoo laawol teskinngol
En fodaniino aljanna ko njoɓdi men e goonɗinal men
Kaɓirɗe amen e sawru amen ngonti mboodi yeeso gite amen, kono min cuɓii ɗooftaare

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Caɗeele ummoraade e gelooɗi debbo Annabi Salih

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
